memory_candidates.content: When planning a global find-and-replace across a large markdown SKILL.md, re-verify every grep count from a research report before trusting it: a phrase that is single-line at some call sites is often line-wrapped at others, so an exact-substring count silently undercounts. In skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md the phrase '`memory_context`, `lit_context`, and `effort_note`.' matches only the 7 single-task dispatch sites; the 3 multi-task loop sites wrap it across two lines, and only the shorter substring '`lit_context`, and `effort_note`.' reaches all 10. Pick the shortest substring that is still unique, and make the pre-edit grep count a hard abort gate in the plan rather than a note.
